meta.note: SEED DATA — hand-maintained flat file, not authoritative. Verify branch EOL dates, latest patch levels and CVE fix versions against Adobe security bulletins (helpx.adobe.com/security) and the Magento release notes before relying on a verdict. This file is the single source the version check reads; a future DB would expose the same shape.

_comment_eolBranches: Keyed by the major.minor string /magento_version reports (Magento only discloses e.g. '2.4', not the patch level). Whole-branch end-of-life => high risk regardless of patch.
_comment_minorLines: Per-2.4.x-line status, used when the exact version is known (from a future asset-hash fingerprint, or when a minor version leaks). status: eol | maintenance | supported.
_comment_vulnerabilities: Notable vulnerabilities. fixedIn lists the first patched version PER minor line; a store on a version below the fix for its own line is affected. platforms gates M1 vs M2. Only asserted as 'confirmed' when the detected version is precise enough (minor or patch level); on a branch-only detection they are surfaced as 'possible if unpatched'.
